You decide to redistribute the number of coins you have so that all eight bags you hold have the same number of coins. oczekiwana_odpowiedz: If there are $b$ gold coins in each of the original 7 bags, then $7b+53$ is divisible by 8. In other words, $7b + 53 \equiv 0 \pmod{8}$. Since $53 \equiv 5 \pmod{8}$ and $7 \equiv -1 \pmod{8}$, we have that $-b \equiv -5 \pmod{8}$. Multiplying both sides by $-1$, we get that $b \equiv 5 \pmod{8}$. Now, we want $7b + 53 > 200$, so as a result, $b > \frac{200-53}{7} \implies b > 21$. Therefore, we want an integer greater than 21 which leaves a remainder of 5 when divided by 8. The least such integer is 29, so you had $29 \cdot 7 = \boxed{203}$ coins before finding the bag of 53 coins.
